title: Counting on Suppression: Does Learning to Ignore Distractors Depend on Executive Resources? A Registered Report: Data, code, and materials
description: Data, analysis code, results, and task materials for the Stage 1 Registered Report "Counting on Suppression: Does Learning to Ignore Distractors Depend on Executive Resources? A Registered Report". The repository includes the data of Vicente-Conesa et al. (2023) used to plan the sample size, the statistics extracted for the meta-analysis, the scripts of the meta-analysis, the simulation-based power and sensitivity analyses, and the preregistered analyses (which run on simulated data of both groups until data collection), the cached results and figures, the online task of both groups (jsPsych), and the Quarto source file of the manuscript. See README.md for the structure of the repository and how to reproduce the analyses.
